title: lightningpixel/modly
claim: lightningpixel/modly — Desktop app to generate 3D models from images using local AI, running entirely on your GPU.
hook: Photo-to-3D is a real time-saver — but the money is going to Meshy and Rodin, and 'local' is a thin moat.
why_good: Turn any photo into a textured 3D mesh with open-source AI models running entirely on your own GPU; a desktop app for Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon macOS.
value: Buyer: indie game studios and 3D-print shops generating models in volume. Money: a local pro edition plus Blender/Unity/print-slicer pipeline integrations.
risk: Who kills it: Meshy and Rodin own quality, clean topology and native Unity/Unreal/Blender export and iterate fast; GPU makers push on-device too. If local quality can't keep up, teams pay the cloud meter — one to watch, not to bet on.

zh.claim: lightningpixel/modly —— 从图片生成 3D 模型的桌面 app,完全在你本地 GPU 上运行。
zh.hook: 图生 3D 确实省时间——但钱正流向 Meshy 和 Rodin,而『本地』这条护城河很薄。
zh.why_good: 把任意一张照片变成带纹理的 3D 网格,用开源 AI 模型、完全在你本地 GPU 上运行;支持 Windows / Linux / Apple Silicon macOS 的桌面 app。
zh.value: 买家:批量出模型的独立游戏工作室和 3D 打印店。变现:本地专业版 + Blender/Unity/切片器管线集成。
zh.risk: 谁会杀死它:Meshy、Rodin 已握住质量、干净拓扑和原生 Unity/Unreal/Blender 导出且迭代飞快,GPU 厂商也在推端侧。本地质量追不上,团队就宁可交云端的钱——现在是观察对象,不是下注对象。
zh.does: 把任意一张照片变成带纹理的 3D 网格,用开源 AI 模型、完全在你本地 GPU 上运行;支持 Windows / Linux / Apple Silicon macOS 的桌面 app。
zh.edge: 完全本地、开源、在自己 GPU 上跑——素材不出本机,也没有按次计费。
zh.why_use: 适合要无限量或对隐私敏感、不愿把每个素材都过云的独立团队——这是它相对 Meshy、Rodin 这类云端工具唯一真正的差异点。

does: Turn any photo into a textured 3D mesh with open-source AI models running entirely on your own GPU; a desktop app for Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon macOS.
edge: Fully local, open-source, on your own GPU — assets never leave your machine and there's no per-generation meter.
why_use: Fits indie teams that need unlimited or privacy-sensitive generation without piping every asset through a cloud — its one genuine edge over cloud tools like Meshy and Rodin.
